subject: Request: Temporary Forensic Retention Waiver & Adjusted Backup Purge Window
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aureliahealth.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aureliahealth.com
Date: 2026-06-20T09:14:00Z
Subject: Request: Temporary forensic retention waiver & backup purge adjustment

Hi Olga,

We opened an incident this morning (AURE-1129) after an integrity check flagged unexpected tokenization variance in a batch of inference logs tied to our sandbox environment. Our security team needs a short window to preserve backups and full interaction logs for a forensic review — specifically, an extension of the backup purge timeline from 7 days to 21 days for the affected customer_id(s) listed below.

Affected customer IDs: AH-7B2, AH-7B3
Scope: chat logs, request/response payloads, system debug logs for 2026-06-15 -> 2026-06-19
Requested retention: +14 days (total 21 days) on backups and extended log retention for these IDs; prevent deletion/purge while the investigation is open.

We realize this is an exception to normal data hygiene. Could you confirm Redwood's ability to apply a targeted retention waiver and provide an updated purge timeline and who on your side will sign off? Also please indicate any DPA/processing change notes we should track.

Attachments: forensic_scope.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Security Operations Manager
Aurelia Health

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary forensic retention waiver & backup purge adjustment

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the details and the scope doc. We can implement a targeted retention waiver while the investigation is active, but I need to coordinate with Legal and Infra for a controlled exception window and audit trail. Next steps on our side:

- I will open an internal change with Infra to suspend scheduled purge for the specific customer IDs you listed (target: within 4 business hours).
- Legal (cc Kim) will confirm any DPA addendum language required for a short-term retention change; Kim, can you advise on whether a short-term “forensic waiver” addendum is sufficient or if we need a signed amendment?
- Rishi, can you prepare an isolated snapshot export and a read-only access token for Aurelia's investigators? Please include a checksum and retention marker.

Liam, once we have Legal approval I will send a one-page waiver for signature (DocuSign link preferred).

Olga
Olga Petrov
Sr. Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T12:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary forensic retention waiver & backup purge adjustment

Olga —

Legal is OK with a short-term forensic retention waiver provided:
- It's narrowly scoped to the customer IDs and date range provided.
- The waiver includes a defined expiration (14 days from issuance) and requires written confirmation from Aurelia to extend.
- We record the waiver as an exception in the DPA change log; no permanent DPA amendment required for <30-day deviations.

I'll draft the one-page waiver (proposed_retention_waiver.docx) and include a clause referencing the DPA section on "Investigation-related temporary retention." Once drafted, I'll send to procurement for signature.

Also: procurement/legal will want a list of exported artifacts and a handoff checklist for custody transfer. Markus — please coordinate with Infra for checksum + S3 ACLs.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Lead Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T08:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary forensic retention waiver & backup purge adjustment

Team —

Infra update: we can suspend the automated purge job for the specific object prefixes (customers/AH-7B2/* and customers/AH-7B3/*) and tag the snapshots with retention:forensic-AH-20260620. Estimated ETA for the safe snapshot and ACL-handled export is 6 hours from approval.

Planned deliverables:
1) Read-only snapshot export (S3 URI) + sha256 checksums (attachment: audit_log_sample.csv)
2) Short-lived access token scoped to the snapshot (48hr window)
3) Audit entry with who/when/purpose into our compliance ledger (INF-4823)
4) Purge rule will remain disabled for those prefixes until waiver expiry or written confirmation to resume

I will not release anything until Legal confirms the waiver language.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior SRE, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aureliahealth.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aureliahealth.com
Date: 2026-06-24T16:55:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary forensic retention waiver & backup purge adjustment

Olga / Kim / Rishi —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the waiver and confirms Aurelia is prepared to sign the one-page forensic waiver once it's shared. A couple of clarifications:

- We need the export to include full request/response bodies and server-side trace ids.
- Will Redwood include a signed custody log at time of handoff? That helps our audit.
- If the investigation requires an extension beyond the initial 14 days, we'll request it in writing referencing the original waiver and incident ID.

Please send the DocuSign link when ready and confirm the planned snapshot ETA.

Thanks,
Liam
Security Operations Manager
Aurelia Health
